page.layout: One column of running text, with a handwritten annotation in the left margin. The running head and page number are at the top.

main_text.p: cōcertatio ex Iuris scripti, ac non scripti comparatione nascitur, quanquam ex Pandectarum iure nihil iam propter bonorum publicatione ea res dubitationis habeat. L. si quis, 9. & L. quia latronib. 13.[?] D. de testament. Eiusdem modi quæstio illa fuit nobilis, de qua Principes ciuitatis Sceuolam[?], Manilium & Brutum dissensisse, Cic. lib. De fi-nib. 2 testatur: an partus ancillæ in fructu habendus sit. A similibus enim, aut paribus potius, argumentatio sume-batur, hoc modo: Lex est, Fructum omnem qui percipi ex animalibus potest, fructua-rius

page.notes: The handwritten annotation in the left margin (beside "Eiusdem modi") is manuscript, not printed, so it is left out. The running head is only partly legible: "III." is clear, the title after it is not. "Sceuolam" and the "13." after "latronib." are uncertain. The printed page number is "128" at top left.
